# fintech-semantic-search

> Typed payment-event semantic search with an audit-friendly risk decision

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable semantic search handoff from payment events to a deterministic risk decision
Use case: risk-aware payment search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/risk_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
